description: Polish, performance optimization, and design system expansion for multi-species pages
steps: Expand src/style.css with new styles for: (a) species gallery grid layout with responsive columns, (b) species card styles with ecosystem-specific accent colors, (c) IUCN status badge styles (color-coded: CR=red, EN=orange, VU=yellow, NT=green, LC=blue), (d) species profile page layout styles (hero, taxonomy grid, media cards, threats list), (e) navigation header/breadcrumb styles, (f) species page section transitions. Maintain the existing glass/pastel design language throughout.

Add a lightweight navigation header component that appears on all pages: shows site title (links to index), and on species pages shows a breadcrumb (Home > Species > {name}). Style it as a subtle glass bar at the top. Create src/nav.js for the navigation logic.

Implement lazy loading for species pages: species page JS should only load when visiting a species page (dynamic import). The species gallery images (if any) should use loading='lazy'. Ensure Three.js globe is still lazy-loaded only on the index page.

Add CSS transitions and micro-interactions to species cards: hover state reveals more info, focus states for accessibility, smooth transitions between states. Add a subtle parallax scroll effect to species page hero sections.
Ensure full accessibility: all interactive elements have focus states, proper ARIA labels, keyboard navigation between species cards, skip-to-content link, proper heading hierarchy on all pages.

Update the vision section on index.html to reflect the now-expanded state of the project (it currently says 'coming soon: 500+ species' - update to acknowledge the current 10 species as a foundation, keep future vision aspirational).
acceptance_criteria: All species cards have hover/focus states that are keyboard accessible
IUCN status badges are visually distinct by status level
Navigation breadcrumb appears on species pages
Species page JS is code-split (separate chunk in build output)
All pages pass basic accessibility checks (proper headings, ARIA labels, focus management)
Vision section text is updated to reflect current state
verification: Run npm run build and confirm success
Check dist/ assets to verify code splitting (multiple JS chunks)
Verify the built site structure is complete and all pages reference valid assets
findings: Build succeeds. Navigation component renders on all pages. Skip-to-content links added to index and all 10 species pages. IUCN badge colors adjusted for WCAG contrast compliance. Species card focus-visible styles match scroll-nav pattern. Vision section updated with current state language. Globe lazy-loading still works via IntersectionObserver. Code splitting confirmed (species-page chunk separate from main). The 535KB globe chunk warning is pre-existing and expected (Three.js).
